postconditions.description: The number of cities in Byteforces and the number of cities being attacked are within the specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: 1 <= u_i, v_i <= n for all i
postconditions.description: The city numbers on each road are within the range of city numbers.

postconditions.expression: All cities being attacked are distinct
postconditions.description: The cities being attacked are unique.
The output city number is a valid city number in Byteforces.
The output time is a non-negative integer.
The output time is the minimum possible time to scare all humans.
The output city is the one with the lowest number among those that minimize the time.
